name: @diagrammo/dgmo-mcp
description: MCP server for rendering DGMO diagrams — SVG/PNG output, browser preview, HTML reports, and 40+ chart types. Works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and any MCP client.

scripts.build:fast: tsup src/index.ts src/suggest/scoring.ts src/suggest/selection-tools.ts src/render-helpers.ts --format esm
scripts.dev: tsup src/index.ts src/suggest/scoring.ts src/suggest/selection-tools.ts src/render-helpers.ts --format esm --dts --watch
scripts.studio: pnpm -C ../dgmo build && node tools/guidance-studio/use-local-dgmo.mjs && pnpm build && node tools/guidance-studio/dump-registry.mjs && node tools/guidance-studio/build-gallery.mjs && { if command -v claim-port >/dev/null 2>&1; then claim-port 4347 || { [ $? -eq 3 ] || exit 1; exit 0; }; fi; vite tools/guidance-studio --port 4347 --strictPort; }
scripts.studio:npm: node tools/guidance-studio/dump-registry.mjs && pnpm build && node tools/guidance-studio/build-gallery.mjs && { if command -v claim-port >/dev/null 2>&1; then claim-port 4347 || { [ $? -eq 3 ] || exit 1; exit 0; }; fi; vite tools/guidance-studio --port 4347 --strictPort; }
scripts.check:all: pnpm format:check && pnpm check:deadcode && pnpm check:duplication && pnpm check:deps && pnpm test

author: Diagrammo LLC
